runner: Existing cargo test relay::tests on Windows CI only
environment: Windows CI, pinned actual Node relay with own loopback/data; controlled stalled event POST and delayed native dispatch, no CLI or operating data

cases.scenario: Few large replies force eviction by bytes before 256-entry cap
cases.expectedBehavior: Old large key is evicted, latest remains replayable and bytes <=16MiB
cases.sensitivityReason: Direct byte-cap boundary; removing byte-cap condition permits five 3MiB replies and sixth exceeds16MiB

cases.scenario: Actual registered relay with first event POST stalled by owned fixture; subsequent native forwards reach 4MiB or32 queue cap
cases.entryPoint: RelayState forward → actual native event worker and bounded channel
cases.expectedBehavior: Explicit error and aborted network, queue never above bytes cap; stop/reconnect succeeds
cases.oracle: Contract4MiB/32 messages; independently bounded sends, actual server records blocked POST
cases.sensitivityReason: Tests real queue not a fixed counter; stall is declared fault injection rather than fake successful transport

cases.scenario: Four actual relay invokes wait before same owned Engine effect; explicit stop and reconnect; fifth denied until accepted commands finish
cases.entryPoint: Real browser /api/invoke → native relay dispatch → same Engine
cases.expectedBehavior: Disconnect releases network but pending4 survive; new connection cannot bypass global4; four original effects complete once and old failure cannot change new status
cases.oracle: Independent owned Engine project count0 then4, response rejection and status generation
cases.sensitivityReason: Actual async dispatch lifetime under controlled gate; tests Engine effects, not just task or permit count
